detailed_description: Markdown Table Generator creates a Markdown table from an editable browser table. Start with a 3-column sample table, add or remove rows and columns, edit cell text directly, choose left, center, or right alignment per column, and copy the generated Markdown output. The page also shows a simple table preview. It does not support drag-and-drop editing, merged cells, column resizing, syntax validation, or file downloads.
usage_steps: Edit the header and body cells in the table.
Use Add Row or Add Column when you need more table space.
Remove extra rows or columns with the delete buttons.
Choose left, center, or right alignment for each column.
Review the generated Markdown and preview table.
Click Copy to copy the Markdown output.
usage_examples: Create a small feature comparison table for a README file.
Draft a simple API parameter table for documentation.
Build a basic project status table with aligned numeric columns.
Turn a few rows of manually entered data into Markdown table syntax.
